name: Long Sơn Pagoda
kicker: The seated white Buddha above the pagoda
summary: White Buddha on a city hill: climb to the seated figure in daylight for the statue over Nha Trang. Long Sơn is at 22 đường 23 tháng 10 and opens 07:00–17:30. The provincial guide, citing Báo Khánh Hòa, gives 24 m from the ground and a 14 m statue. Vietnam Tourism gives 78 feet.
getThere: 22 đường 23 tháng 10, at the foot of núi Trại Thủy.
heroCaption: The seated white Buddha on the lotus pedestal
body: Long Sơn is also called the White Buddha Pagoda and Đăng Long tự. The address is 22 đường 23 tháng 10, at the foot of núi Trại Thủy. Older records say phường Phương Sơn. Newer wording says phường Tây Nha Trang. Hours are 07:00–17:30. Climb from the pagoda to the seated white figure on the hill.

Citing Báo Khánh Hòa, the provincial guide gives 24 m from the ground, 21 m from the base, a lotus pedestal 10 m wide, and the statue itself 14 m. Vietnam Tourism gives a 78-foot Buddha. Keep both height lines. Go in daylight so the white figure reads against the sky.

figures.caption: The face and the lotus, in a second photograph of the same seated figure
figures.alt: Close view of the white seated Buddha at Long Sơn

gettingThere: The pagoda is at 22 đường 23 tháng 10. Ride inland from the beach or from the station in the centre.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: Ride inland to đường 23 tháng 10, then walk up to the seated figure.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station is in the centre. The pagoda is on đường 23 tháng 10.
